12.0 NON–MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS:
The status of compliance with discretionary requirements under Regulation 27(1) read with Part-E of Schedule-II of SEBI Regulations are as
under:
• The Company has been getting unqualified audit report from Statutory Auditors and C&AG for last several years which indicate a regime
of unqualified financial statements.
• The Internal Auditors report to the Chief Internal Auditor of the Company and in turn, the Chief Internal Auditor reports to the Audit
Committee.
